status: prospective primary external-validation design frozen before any numeric GPS height value is opened
prerequisites_before_height_opening: raw file obtained through an authorized Dryad route and checksum recorded
species mapping resolved under species_mapping_contract_v1.json or the programme stops
structural gate including exact 5-km common-support/evaluability executed without numeric height and not altered after output
exact eligible species, individual ids, target nights, training-night universe and supported-event counts frozen in a preflight receipt

species_mapping.exchangeability: identity labels are never permuted across species

session_definition.if_timestamp_has_time: timestamp shifted backward by 12 hours then calendar date

structural_eligibility.presence_qualified_row: nonblank id, timestamp, longitude, latitude and height presence only; height magnitude remains unopened
structural_eligibility.target_common_support: for each candidate target night, count target rows whose frozen 5-km cell is present in at least one other >=50-fix night of the same individual and at least one >=50-fix night of another individual of the same species
structural_eligibility.estimator_evaluable_individual: at least one target night with >=50 target common-support events
structural_eligibility.species_panel_gate: a species contributes to the source-level primary statistic only if at least 3 estimator-evaluable individuals from that species remain
structural_eligibility.exact_preflight_freeze: freeze exact eligible species, individual IDs, target nights, training-night universe and supported-event counts before numeric height is opened
structural_eligibility.no_rescue: do not lower fix/session, supported-event, species-panel or source gates after structural output

horizontal_processing.grid_origin: native EPSG:32648 origin; no data-dependent translation

vertical_processing.parse_rule: every structurally retained nonblank height must parse to finite numeric; any failure aborts rather than silently dropping rows
vertical_processing.session_centering: subtract the median source AGL height of the full retained nightly session before vertical binning

estimator.self_profile: equal-weight other eligible nights of the same individual within species
estimator.other_profile: pool eligible nights within each other individual, then equal-weight other individuals within the same species
estimator.common_cell_weighting: on target-supported cells available in both predictors, derive equal-night self training cell weights and apply the identical cell weights to self and other vertical profiles
estimator.session_score: mean over supported target events of log P_self(centered z) - log P_other(centered z)
estimator.source_aggregation: equal eligible species panel; if only one species passes the species-panel gate, the source-level statistic equals that eligible species statistic

primary_null.action: permute individual identity labels across eligible nightly sessions while preserving the exact number of sessions assigned to each identity; keep x-y, date, centered height outcomes and session membership fixed
primary_null.pipeline: recompute evaluability, target support, self/other profiles, common-cell weights and source-level statistic for every permutation

primary: eligible species panels and individual counts
reporting.species_specific_p_values: may be reported as descriptive diagnostics but do not replace the frozen source-level primary verdict

interpretation_matrix.PASS: A genuinely response-unopened external Hipposideros source supports centered individual vertical-distribution identity under species-stratified exchangeability.
interpretation_matrix.FAIL: The external Hipposideros source does not meet the frozen replication criterion. Do not rescue with alternate grid size, vertical bins, species pooling, lower session thresholds or alternate altitude endpoints.

prohibited_after_height_opening: change preflight-frozen target-night or training-night universe
select a species as primary based on its vertical result
open temperature, speed, competition or other mechanism extensions as a rescue if the primary source-level test fails
future_mechanism_boundary: The source temperature, speed and other ecological fields are not part of the primary external validation. Any mechanism extension requires a new frozen contract and cannot alter the primary verdict.
